items.html: And it is in this manner. For behold, it was clarified that the externality of the NHY enters within ZA, but their internality remained above, and that life and internality enlarges and gives the power of enlargement to the upper vessels, so that they grow in the manner of the growing of the small one, and make for it new NHY of externality, which are the vessels. But not literally new, for that is impossible; rather, the upper garments and vessels grow and lengthen, until they also clothe the NHY of the self and the internality.
